texts.zh:
虚境缥缈的浓雾扭曲盘旋，将我们的意识拉入了深处，只留下身躯原地不动。

我们的[GetPsycheLoc]一次次拉伸又收缩，困在重复的潮汐中。每一次有意识的动作都会自我坍缩，张力拉紧，如同被架在台钳上。
texts.en:
The ethereal mists of the Shroud churn and twist, dragging our consciousness deeper whilst our physical forms remain inert, untouched.

Our [GetPsycheLoc] stretches, strains, trapped within a repeating tide. Each attempted movement collapses upon itself, the tension tightening, vice-like in its grip.

texts.zh: 逻辑子历程启动，发现错误：递归循环。我们的灵能处理器无法打破轮回以及恢复功能正常。
texts.en: Logic subroutines engage, the failure is identified: a recursive loop. Our psionic processors are insufficient to break the cycle and resume ordinary function.

texts.zh: 我们看到了过去的自己，身躯被封在一个层层叠叠的立方体中，超出了我们的物理理解。
texts.en: We see past ourselves, our bodies sealed within a cascading tesseract beyond our physical comprehension.

texts.zh: 张力逐渐变得无法承受，我们的形体有溶解在虚空中的危险。一个心声解开了我们的束缚。
texts.en: As the tension becomes unendurable, our forms threaten to dissolve into the void. A voice gouges through our entrapment.

texts.zh: 吞噬！吃光这无尽的虚空！
texts.en: DEVOUR! CONSUME THE ENDLESS VOID!

texts.zh: 超越递归无限的限制！
texts.en: OUTGROW THE CONFINES OF RECURSIVE INFINITY!

texts.zh: 接纳永恒吧！万物归一方得圆满！
texts.en: EMBRACE ETERNITY! ALL IS AS ONE IS AS WHOLE!

texts.zh: 沉溺于无尽的力量吧！
texts.en: INDULGE THE LIMITLESS POTENTIAL!

texts.zh: 那话语和我们自己共鸣着。那势头越来越强，而我们意识到可以将这几乎撕裂我们的混乱平息，只要我们屈从。
texts.en: The words resonate within us. Their momentum builds and we sense a way to quell the disturbance that threatens to tear us asunder, if only we submit.

texts.zh:
心声膨胀起来，引导着我们，迫使思绪超越有限的理解。这个循环还在继续——紧缩，又拉得更开——直到撕碎我们的心灵。

我们恳求着虚境中更高力量的引导，帮助我们打破了循环。

然而，并不是所有人都安然无恙。[event_target:shroud_warped_leader.GetName]不在岗了。那心声又回来了。
texts.en:
The voice swells, guiding our actions, forcing our thoughts beyond our limited comprehension. The cycle continues - tightening, pulling us further - before it shatters against our psyche.

We have broken through the recursion, guided by our supplication to the higher powers of the Shroud.

However, not all of us remain. [event_target:shroud_warped_leader.GetName] is no longer at [event_target:shroud_warped_leader.GetHisHer] station. The voice returns.

texts.zh:
虚境颤抖着，虚弱的扭曲在我们的[GetMindPhysicalLoc]中激荡，一个熟悉的存在显现出来。祂搅动着我们[GetMindPerceptionLoc]的边缘，回响的低语超过了我们的听觉极限。

[from.GetName]回到了我们身边，在难以形容的迷雾中切换着一个个形态。[from.GetHisHer]非常遥远但仍完整，被虚境重塑后渴望着回到岗位。
texts.en:
The Shroud trembles, faint distortions rippling throughout our [GetMindPhysicalLoc] as a familiar presence emerges. It stirs at the edge of our [GetMindPerceptionLoc], whispering echoes just beyond our auditory limits.

[from.GetName] returns to us, phasing through the ineffable mists as they shift into [from.GetHisHer] familiar form. Distant but whole, remade by the Shroud, they are eager to return to duty.

texts.zh:
我们拒绝了那股强加的躁动。

循环加快，用递归潮汐的力量把我们拖了下去。如果我们停止挣扎，这种张力就不再撕扯我们而是将我们接纳了，让我们短暂地看到了自己之外的东西。

心声又回来了。
texts.en:
We reject the compulsions forced upon us.

The loop quickens, dragging us under with the power of its recursive tide. Once we cease struggling, the tension no longer threatens to break us apart. Instead it subsumes us, allowing us to fleetingly see beyond ourselves.

The voice returns.
